name: Nieradus
backstory: Child of Nieragus and Dorakus in Salthos Cruzados; raised alongside sits at the square's edge through petition days,..., having heard about CONFLICT-02.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Prince Doran now have a child, Dornakus.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Magus has died.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Darius and Niemus now have a child, Darnus.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Prince Doran now have a child, Dorakus.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Fenserika and Darius now have a child, Darika.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Darnus and Fenserika now have a child, Fenarnus.

criterion.standard: holds themself accountable to Gorff Ledger Crossing War, whatever it costs
criterion.wasted_life: one that never had to answer for Gorff Ledger Crossing War
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: keeps the ledger at the square through petition days, cross-checks each new claim against what's already on file, and flags the ones that don't square with last year's

arc.premise: Nieradus keeps setting the clerk's official record of the old Gorff Ledger Crossing War against the claims that come in comparing losses, trying to work out which side's count of what happened was ever actually right.
